title: Restrict private coach preference writes to fresh direct Space editors

verify.note: Actual save action and direct-editor resolver reject staff/network/foreign/revoked writes before private IO, allow direct owner/editor; authority-bypass source mutation fails. Real-capability tests additionally prove general staff/network editing would permit the old private save; actual narrow service-role upsert preserves both tenants' unrelated private state. Local offline proof, not production acceptance.

detail: Protected coach settings/page/prompt reads intentionally exclude platform staff and inherited network content-management reach. saveSpaceCoachProfile formerly used general getSpaceCapabilities(canEditProfile), which grants both, permitting callers blocked from private reads to overwrite or clear another Space's private steering through service_role. Save and clear now use the same uncached direct-owner/active-editor authority as private discovery and reads. Tests use actual capability resolver, actual direct membership resolver and actual private-state upsert behind inert tenant-aware storage; owner/editor succeed, staff/network/foreign/anonymous/revoked/error cases cannot write. Public content-management rights are unchanged. No schema, provider, customer data, migration, production or deployment changes.
